source_note: Authored 2026-05-16 / extended 2026-05-17 for the v2 evaluation. Each subject is chosen so the idiomatic LLM Rust translation either (a) panics where the C function returns a value (UB-triggering A and sentinel-error C), (b) drops a width / signedness annotation and diverges on the test input (defined-defined A), or (c) operates on Unicode codepoints where C operates on bytes (D).
